cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Could you hold this shelf bracket against the holes? It keeps slipping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Could you turn that top screw once? Then you can let go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's holding. The other screws are already lined up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just tighten those, then? And slide the shelf onto it to check. I'll get your coat.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 wrappers announce professionalism without correcting installation; the sequence of tiny favours clearly performs D25.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 brief availability causes A3 one screw to release grip; B4 lined screws causes A5 completion and shelf check.

relationship.evidence: B2 needs work departure and B4 describes helpful progress, enabling A next small request.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4 near-complete fastening into finishing the whole shelf while A fetches a coat.

specificity.evidence: A1 slipping bracket and B2 work clothes establish task and limited willingness.
